tagline.fr: Reprenez votre appareil photo et repartez pour une toute nouvelle aventure ! Dénichez les détails cachés, aidez vos amis tout au long du chemin et immortalisez les merveilles du monde de TOEM 2, la suite du célèbre premier opus.
tagline.en: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

tagline.fr: Power Network Tycoon est un jeu de simulation de réseau électrique basé sur la physique. Construisez et entretenez un réseau haute tension, gérez vos ressources, recherchez des améliorations et affrontez les défis de la nature pour protéger les habitants de votre île !
tagline.en: Power Network Tycoon is a physics based power grid simulation game where you build and maintain a high-voltage power network. Build power infrastructure, monitor resources, research upgrades, adapt to environmental challenges, keep up with energy demands and protect your island community!

tagline.fr: DiceVaders est un roguelike mêlant deckbuilding et jeu de dés, dans lequel vous menez une invasion extraterrestre. Incarnez les méchants de StarVaders, manipulez vos dés avec stratégie, levez une armée inarrêtable et déclenchez des combos de folie grâce à de puissantes synergies.
tagline.en: Dicevaders is a dice-based roguelike deckbuilder about leading the ultimate alien invasion. Set in the StarVaders universe, draft and manipulate the dice row, build an unstoppable army, and unleash adrenaline pumping combos through powerful synergies and strategic play.

tagline.fr: Construisez votre arme pièce par pièce, faites évoluer ses composants, débloquez de nouvelles technologies et repoussez vos limites à chaque prestige. Créez des armes toujours plus puissantes et absurdes, capables de tirer des milliers de balles.
tagline.en: Build your gun piece by piece, evolve its parts, unlock new technology and push your progression further with every prestige. Create increasingly powerful and absurd weapons, from clever builds to guns capable of firing thousands of bullets.

tagline.fr: ESC ape, You died? est un projet né pour recréer un jeu tenant sur une seule disquette (1,44 Mo) : un jeu de plates-formes à énigmes qui se résout avec l'interface des paramètres de la touche ÉCHAP (menu) et tous les autres éléments d'interface.
tagline.en: ESC ape, You died? started as a project to recreate a game that fits on a single floppy disk (1.44 MB): a platformer where you solve puzzles with the ESC (menu) settings UI and every other piece of UI.

tagline.fr: LeadFall is a fast-paced top-down action roguelike where you survive chaotic waves of food-themed enemies, collect powerful card upgrades, and create broken weapon builds in short, replayable runs.
tagline.en: LeadFall is a fast-paced top-down action roguelike where you survive chaotic waves of food-themed enemies, collect powerful card upgrades, and create broken weapon builds in short, replayable runs.

tagline.fr: Restore a forgotten sanctuary with nine fox spirits in a cozy incremental game. Ring the bell, rebuild their Areas, deepen Bonds, celebrate Festivals, and make memories together.
tagline.en: Restore a forgotten sanctuary with nine fox spirits in a cozy incremental game. Ring the bell, rebuild their Areas, deepen Bonds, celebrate Festivals, and make memories together.

tagline.fr: Forgez votre destin dans un MMO de stratégie en monde persistant. Choisissez une nation et débutez comme simple citoyen. Devenez président, commandant militaire ou magnat des affaires dans un univers vivant façonné par les joueurs, la politique, l’économie et la guerre.
tagline.en: Forge your own destiny in a persistent strategy MMO. Choose a nation and begin your journey as an ordinary citizen. Rise to become a president, military commander, or business tycoon in a living world where players shape politics, the economy, and warfare.

tagline.fr: Gus Game est un party game multijoueur qui vous plonge dans un monde fantastique rempli de mini-jeux hilarants et compétitifs. Gus Game vous permet de vous mesurer à vos amis dans des épreuves telles que le lancer de boulet de canon, le parcours d'obstacles et bien plus encore...
tagline.en: Gus Game is a multiplayer party game that immerses you in a fantastic world full of hilarious and competitive mini-games. Gus Game allows you to compete against your friends in challenges such as cannonball throwing, obstacle courses, and much more...

tagline.fr: Un jeu d’horreur psychologique dans lequel vous repérez des anomalies dans un musée en boucle et choisissez la bonne sortie pour atteindre l’étage G.
tagline.en: A psychological game where you spot anomalies in a looping museum and choose the correct exit to reach G Floor.

tagline.fr: Marble GO est un RPG pixel décontracté alliant combat de billes et construction d’équipement. Lancez des billes pour déclencher des effets, battez des monstres et gagnez équipement & or en mode automatique. Construction libre, collisions satisfaisantes et progression profonde.
tagline.en: Marble GO is a casual pixel RPG with marble combat and gear building. Launch marbles to trigger 20+ effects, defeat monsters, and earn gear & gold via auto-launch idle mode. It offers 7 gear categories, 200+ items & 40+ buffs for custom builds, delivering satisfying collisions and deep progression.

tagline.fr: Commencez petit oiseau, mangez du popcorn et évoluez en force cosmique ! Birb mélange mécanique idle et expéditions roguelite. Construisez votre nid, pêchez, défiez des boss et grimpez au classement mondial. Combien de coups de bec pour dominer le monde ?
tagline.en: Start as a humble birb, eat popcorn, and evolve into a cosmic force of nature! Birb blends addictive idle mechanics with active roguelite expeditions. Build your nest, catch rare fish, challenge bosses, and compete on the global leaderboard. How many pecks will it take to rule the world?

title: Monster Museum: Tidy Up the collection!

tagline.fr: Plongez dans l'univers cosy de Monster Museum ! Faites équipe avec votre créature préférée et lancez-vous dans une aventure pour restaurer le musée en triant 2586 figurines. Débloquez de nouvelles capacités, collectionnez des badges et découvrez ses secrets cachés. Chill, solo, sans chronomètre.
tagline.en: Step into the relaxing world of Monster Museum! Team up with your favorite creature companion and begin your journey to restore the museum by sorting 2586 monster figurines.  Unlock your creature's abilities, sort the museum and uncover hidden secrets along the way. Cozy, single player, no timers.

tagline.fr: Cruise through a world of colorful retro inspired toys in Obstacle Overdrive, a cozy off-roading toy car adventure! Navigate fun, challenging courses, tumultuous tumbles, and enjoy the charm of a miniature world where the obstacles are as playful as the ride itself.
tagline.en: Cruise through a world of colorful retro inspired toys in Obstacle Overdrive, a cozy off-roading toy car adventure! Navigate fun, challenging courses, tumultuous tumbles, and enjoy the charm of a miniature world where the obstacles are as playful as the ride itself.

tagline.fr: Ouvre des paquets, achète des améliorations et collectionne les 1001 cartes et leurs variantes. Crée une véritable usine automatisée à boosters en démultipliant sans cesse la production jusqu'à atteindre le clonage et la fusion nucléaire !
tagline.en: Open booster packs, buy upgrades, and collect over 1001 cards and their variants. Build a true automated booster factory by endlessly multiplying production until you unlock cloning and nuclear fusion !

tagline.fr: Bodycam est le premier FPS multijoueur tactique avec une véritable vue de caméra corporelle dans Unreal Engine 5. Les combats rapprochés semblent bruts et bruyants. Chaque angle, légende et puce compte. Jouez à Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch et Wingman sur des cartes photoréalistes où le jeu d'équipe.
tagline.en: Bodycam is the first tactical multiplayer FPS with a true body-camera view in Unreal Engine 5. Close-quarters combats feel raw and loud. Every angle, callout, and bullet matters. Play Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Wingman on photoreal maps where teamplay, tactics, and clutch skill are key.

tagline.fr: Dreamspring is a dark fantasy styled, open world dungeon crawler inspired by games like Morrowind and King's Field. Explore a dying kingdom and it's different realms in first person action combat, styled in a mix of retro and vaporwave aesthetics.
tagline.en: Dreamspring is a dark fantasy styled, open world dungeon crawler inspired by games like Morrowind and King's Field. Explore a dying kingdom and it's different realms in first person action combat, styled in a mix of retro and vaporwave aesthetics.

title: 慧音的寺子屋 ~ A Schoolhouse in Gensokyo

tagline.fr: Play as Keine Kamishirasawa, the half-beast teacher of Gensokyo! Teach humans and yokai, grow their minds, hearts, and bodies, and guide them to graduation. Balance tradition and change, expand your influence, and build your ideal school. Write your legend on the education frontlines!
tagline.en: Play as Keine Kamishirasawa, the half-beast teacher of Gensokyo! Teach humans and yokai, grow their minds, hearts, and bodies, and guide them to graduation. Balance tradition and change, expand your influence, and build your ideal school. Write your legend on the education frontlines!

tagline.fr: Gamble your life away by buying card packs until your broke, or until you climbed the mountain of money!
tagline.en: Gamble your life away by buying card packs until your broke, or until you climbed the mountain of money!

tagline.fr: You command Ukraine's air defense. Every night — missiles and drone swarms, and always fewer interceptors than targets. By day it's your turn: deep strikes past enemy radars. And when orders aren't enough — take the stick yourself.
tagline.en: You command Ukraine's air defense. Every night — missiles and drone swarms, and always fewer interceptors than targets. By day it's your turn: deep strikes past enemy radars. And when orders aren't enough — take the stick yourself.

tagline.fr: Piworld is a unique multiplayer game where everyone can find something to do to suit their desires. Try out different roles: from a simple fisherman to an adventurer. Explore the world alone or with friends, fight evil, develop your skills, and create your own story.
tagline.en: Piworld is a unique multiplayer game where everyone can find something to do to suit their desires. Try out different roles: from a simple fisherman to an adventurer. Explore the world alone or with friends, fight evil, develop your skills, and create your own story.

tagline.fr: Play Go on 9×9, 13×13, or 19×19 boards with Chinese or Japanese rules. Learn the fundamentals, challenge local AI, play locally with a friend, study and analyze SGF records, or connect to OGS for online games and spectating.
tagline.en: Play Go on 9×9, 13×13, or 19×19 boards with Chinese or Japanese rules. Learn the fundamentals, challenge local AI, play locally with a friend, study and analyze SGF records, or connect to OGS for online games and spectating.

tagline.fr: Study the room, survive the blink, and spot what changed before time runs out. Master 30 handcrafted pixel-art rooms across four difficulty modes, sharpen permanent skills, and test how much you really saw.
tagline.en: Study the room, survive the blink, and spot what changed before time runs out. Master 30 handcrafted pixel-art rooms across four difficulty modes, sharpen permanent skills, and test how much you really saw.

title: Gear Puzzle: the inheritance of grandpa

tagline.fr: A hand-drawn steampunk point-and-click puzzle adventure. Search for clues, combine items and unravel a family mystery. Now includes Chapter 2, a journey into a miniature world, and free hints that recharge every 3 minutes.
tagline.en: A hand-drawn steampunk point-and-click puzzle adventure. Search for clues, combine items and unravel a family mystery. Now includes Chapter 2, a journey into a miniature world, and free hints that recharge every 3 minutes.

tagline.fr: Un jeu de stratégie minimaliste où vous développez votre ville flottante infinie. Combinez des blocks 3D loufoques pour optimiser les synergies, construire des paysages idylliques et battre votre meilleur score.
tagline.en: A minimalist city builder about growing your infinite floating town. Combine 3D blocks to optimize synergies, build idyllic scenery, and chase your high score.

tagline.fr: Plongez dans le chaos cybernétique de Neon Abyss 2. Dans ce nouveau rogue-like jouable jusqu'à 4 joueurs en ligne et offrant de nombreux styles de combat différents et des synergies d'objets illimitées, chaque run vous fera découvrir une expérience pleine d'action que vous n'êtes pas d'oublier.
tagline.en: Dive into the cybermyth roguelike chaos of Neon Abyss 2! Now featuring up to 4-player online co-op, more combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, every run delivers a dramatic, action-packed experience you won't forget.

tagline.fr: Build your deck, bomb your friends into oblivion, and score 9,999 gold with a single card. CatPoker is an online 1–3 player roguelike Dou Dizhu game, packed with adorable cats and tons of fun items. Gather your friends for a match of Dou Dizhu where strategy meets friendship-ending chaos!
tagline.en: Build your deck, bomb your friends into oblivion, and score 9,999 gold with a single card. CatPoker is an online 1–3 player roguelike Dou Dizhu game, packed with adorable cats and tons of fun items. Gather your friends for a match of Dou Dizhu where strategy meets friendship-ending chaos!

tagline.fr: AutoChart est un jeu de rythme au clavier qui donne vie à votre musique. Importez un fichier audio ou vidéo : l’IA génère une partition. Choisissez la difficulté et de 4 à 8 touches, jouez les notes qui défilent au rythme de la musique et battez votre record.
tagline.en: AutoChart is a key-based rhythm game powered by your own music. Import an audio or video file and let AI generate a note chart. Choose your difficulty and a 4–8 key layout, hit the falling notes to the beat, and chase your personal best.

tagline.fr: CELESTAY est un jeu de construction idle et apaisant : pêche des matériaux et fais monter ta maison vers le ciel. Dans un monde calme recouvert d’eau, tu empiles des toits et regardes les étoiles. Plus haut tu vas, plus constellations et souvenirs apparaissent.
tagline.en: CELESTAY is a calm idle building game where you fish for materials and grow your home toward the sky. In a world sunk beneath the sea, you stack pieces of a house and spend quiet days fishing and watching the stars. The higher you build, the more constellations and memories fill your world.

tagline.fr: Silver Pines est un metroidvania d'horreur et de survie qui se déroule dans un petit village américain. Affrontez des monstres effrayants et résolvez des puzzles, mais pensez à gérer vos ressources pour réussir à percer les mystères et sauver votre âme.
tagline.en: Silver Pines is a survival horror metroidvania set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

tagline.fr: Un survival horror coopératif autour d’un jeu de société maudit. Jouez avec un groupe de 6. Lancez les dés, survivez aux horreurs invoquées et battez le maître du jeu pour gagner votre liberté.
tagline.en: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play in a group of 6 players. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.

tagline.fr: Blosharper is a card-shark noir roguelike deckbuilder: forge Korean Hwatu card combos to smash each round's target score. Don't rely on luck—use illicit "cheat" skills to rig the deck and survive a deadly underground gambling den. Pay off your debt, defeat the bosses, become the ultimate sharp!
tagline.en: Blosharper is a card-shark noir roguelike deckbuilder: forge Korean Hwatu card combos to smash each round's target score. Don't rely on luck—use illicit "cheat" skills to rig the deck and survive a deadly underground gambling den. Pay off your debt, defeat the bosses, become the ultimate sharp!

tagline.fr: 2D top-down survival game with multiplayer and procedural world generation
tagline.en: 2D top-down survival game with multiplayer and procedural world generation

tagline.fr: In this first person experience, you are returning home after a long day of work. Turn off all of the lights on each floor of the office before you depart. Use the elevator to travel between floors, and be on the lookout for any unusual behavior from your coworkers.
tagline.en: In this first person experience, you are returning home after a long day of work. Turn off all of the lights on each floor of the office before you depart. Use the elevator to travel between floors, and be on the lookout for any unusual behavior from your coworkers.

tagline.fr: Dans un monde de carton tout mignon, quelque chose a effroyablement dégénéré... Utilisez le crayon magique, le bon vieux pompe et diverses autres armes, sans oublier la force de vos puissantes bottes, pour percer la sombre vérité et découvrir POURQUOI DU CARTON... QUI SAIGNE ?
tagline.en: In the cute cardboard world, something went horribly wrong... Use the magical pencil, a good old shotgun, and various other weapons as well as the strength of your mighty boots, to uncover the dark truth and find out WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED?

tagline.fr: Sidewalk Simulator combines fast-paced shootout combat with a deep tower defense upgrade economy. Build, dodge, unlock, and fight to survive endless waves of 100+ unique enemies. Find balance between movement, power, and defense in each strange world you encounter.
tagline.en: Sidewalk Simulator combines fast-paced shootout combat with a deep tower defense upgrade economy. Build, dodge, unlock, and fight to survive endless waves of 100+ unique enemies. Find balance between movement, power, and defense in each strange world you encounter.

tagline.fr: Dans un monde médiéval, rassemblez des ressources, construisez votre ville et gérez votre peuple. Faites face aux vols, accomplissez des missions royales et combattez vos ennemis. Utilisez la stratégie et la gestion économique pour faire prospérer votre ville.
tagline.en: In a medieval world, gather resources, build your city, and manage your people. Deal with theft and internal conflicts, complete royal missions, and fight enemies on the battlefield. Use strategy and economic management to keep your city thriving.

tagline.fr: NekoTrak mêle suivi du temps et évolution de votre chat. Élevez un chat pixelisé sur votre bureau. Gagnez de l’expérience, ramassez des pièces et débloquez des chats, jouez à plusieurs pour qu’ils se rencontrent. Suivez vos applications et partagez activités, musique et tâches sur Steam et Discord.
tagline.en: NekoTrak blends time tracking with focus-based pet care. Raise a cat that roams your desktop. Earn experience, collect coins, and unlock cats, and play multiplayer so your cats can meet. It tracks app and website time and shares your activity, music, and tasks on Steam and Discord.

tagline.fr: Saddle up for the wildest idle RPG this side of the Mississippi. Fight outlaws, duel rival cowboys, craft legendary gear, conquer world bosses, and build your frontier legacy — all set on a retro desktop OS straight outta 1998.
tagline.en: Saddle up for the wildest idle RPG this side of the Mississippi. Fight outlaws, duel rival cowboys, craft legendary gear, conquer world bosses, and build your frontier legacy — all set on a retro desktop OS straight outta 1998.

tagline.fr: A dark comedy call center simulator where you answer calls, verify identities, catch fraudsters, and run side hustles under your supervisor's watchful eye. The queue never empties. The pay never improves.
tagline.en: A dark comedy call center simulator where you answer calls, verify identities, catch fraudsters, and run side hustles under your supervisor's watchful eye. The queue never empties. The pay never improves.

title: BOSS ARENA: The Goldilock One Trials

tagline.fr: Chaque porte cache un défi. Affrontez des vagues incessantes et des boss puissants dans ce RPG d'action arcade gratuit et autonome. Gagnez de l'XP, développez votre combattant et combinez armes, armures et talents. Anticipez les attaques, maîtrisez votre timing et faites vos preuves dans l'Arène.
tagline.en: Every door holds a new challenge. Face relentless waves and powerful bosses in this free standalone arcade/action RPG. Earn XP, shape your fighter, and combine weapons, armor, and abilities into your own build. Read enemy attacks, master your timing, and prove yourself in the Arena.

tagline.fr: Someone is secretly hastening the revival of the "Black Devil" that assaults the Disodart Continent every few decades. Taking the situation gravely, the royal capital entrusts the tower's investigation to a church priestess. But that priestess is a young, innocent maiden…
tagline.en: Someone is secretly hastening the revival of the "Black Devil" that assaults the Disodart Continent every few decades. Taking the situation gravely, the royal capital entrusts the tower's investigation to a church priestess. But that priestess is a young, innocent maiden…

tagline.fr: Comedy horror set in Somerset. You're on the night shift again. Look lively, you get all sorts turning up round these parts. Let the right ones in, send the wronguns on their way and try not to make any enemies— there are strange folk about.
tagline.en: Comedy horror set in Somerset. You're on the night shift again. Look lively, you get all sorts turning up round these parts. Let the right ones in, send the wronguns on their way and try not to make any enemies— there are strange folk about.

title: 告死天使招魂令 Death Angel Requiem

tagline.fr: A 5-hour horror game where investigator Igarashi, tasked by the police, enters a haunted campus after a murder case kills four students. With her partner Shimo, she sets out to uncover the truth behind the "ghost killings."
tagline.en: A 5-hour horror game where investigator Igarashi, tasked by the police, enters a haunted campus after a murder case kills four students. With her partner Shimo, she sets out to uncover the truth behind the "ghost killings."

tagline.fr: Un jeu d’aventure chaotique rempli de mini-jeux et de références aux mèmes, où vous livrez des pizzas, affrontez des robots, faites des blagues et affrontez une IA qui veut mettre fin à la folie.
tagline.en: A chaotic adventure game packed with minigames and meme references, where you deliver pizzas, fight robots, pull pranks and take on an AI trying to wipe out the fun.

tagline.fr: Run a restaurant in a bizarre universe and cook for customers who call themselves "gods"! Expand your restaurant, deploy robots, and automate your kitchen. Keep business booming—and be ready to deal with any unruly customers.
tagline.en: Run a restaurant in a bizarre universe and cook for customers who call themselves "gods"! Expand your restaurant, deploy robots, and automate your kitchen. Keep business booming—and be ready to deal with any unruly customers.

tagline.fr: Burn with me est un deck-builder narratif plein de terreur feutrée et de mystères occultes. Pour invoquer votre démon intérieur, vous devrez maîtriser un système de jeu inventif, exploiter des synergies de placement et ne pas hésiter à sacrifier vos cartes... et votre âme.
tagline.en: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

tagline.fr: Gridlords est un autobattler stratégique en JcJ asynchrone. Dans un univers de fantasy en pixel art, construisez le château ultime, menez des héros légendaires au combat et surpassez vos adversaires grâce à vos qualités de stratège.
tagline.en: Gridlords is a strategic async-PvP autobattler set in a fantasy pixel-art world. Build your ultimate castle, command legendary heroes, and outsmart rivals to prove your strategy reigns supreme.

tagline.fr: Le RPG idle minuscule par excellence ! De adorables héros en pixel attendent de te rejoindre pour l'aventure — depuis ta barre des tâches. Combats l'ennui du quotidien et du travail avec des classes, compétences, objets et builds variés !
tagline.en: The ultimate tiny idle RPG! Adorable pixel heroes are waiting to join your adventure — from your taskbar. Fight off the boredom of work and daily life with diverse classes, skills, items, and builds!

tagline.fr: RADIOSOL is a journey through a desolate world burned by a planetary cataclysm. In search of answers, you will have to navigate through the ruins of megastructures and abandoned cities, avoiding the scorching rays of the Sun.
tagline.en: RADIOSOL is a journey through a desolate world burned by a planetary cataclysm. In search of answers, you will have to navigate through the ruins of megastructures and abandoned cities, avoiding the scorching rays of the Sun.

tagline.fr: Gamblers Table est un jeu d’automatisation incrémental. Lancez des pièces pour gagner de l’argent, améliorez vos pièces et engagez des assistants pour automatiser le tout. Simple. Satisfaisant. Étrangement captivant...
tagline.en: Gamblers Table is an incremental game where you toss coins to earn money. Buy bigger and better coins, unlock upgrades and hire little helpers to automate the process and take care of all the busy flipping work for you. Simple. Satisfying. Strangely compelling...

tagline.fr: Teamfight Manager revient avec une gestion et des tactiques plus détaillées, un nouveau format de match de style MOBA, ainsi qu’un mode Match à mort rappelant le précédent opus. Prenez la tête d’une équipe d’esport fictive, bâtissez la meilleure équipe et devenez le meilleur manager !
tagline.en: Teamfight Manager returns with more detailed tactics and management, a new MOBA-style match format, and a Deathmatch mode reminiscent of the previous title. Take charge of a fictional esports team, build the strongest roster, and become the best manager!

tagline.fr: Dirigez un royaume affaibli et essayez de satisfaire les petits besoins de vos gens dans ce RPG cinématique de gestion. Équilibrez vos ressources, collectez des taxes, recrutez des agents et faites des choix cornéliens qui vous mèneront à la prospérité ou à l’échec.
tagline.en: Rule your crumbling kingdom as you try to satisfy the petty needs of your people in this cinematic kingdom management RPG. Balance your resources, collect taxes, hire agents and make difficult decisions to see your kingdom prosper or fail.

tagline.fr: Deckbuilding tactique en sessions courtes. Lance des dés, crée des réactions en chaîne magiques. Choisis parmi différentes classes de héros aux capacités uniques. Construis des synergies entre dés, reliques et runes pour vaincre des boss redoutables.
tagline.en: A physics-driven roguelite deckbuilder that's easy to pick up and hard to put down. Launch dice to trigger satisfying chain-reaction merges. Choose from distinct hero classes with unique abilities. Build synergies between dice, relics, and runes to defeat challenging bosses.

tagline.fr: Pratiquez votre hobby préféré pour restaurer un quartier oublié une pièce à la fois. Dans Hozy, nettoyez, peignez et décorez avec des mécaniques satisfaisantes et des contrôles intuitifs. Profitez des détails alors que vous manipulez outils, objets et meubles pour redonner vie à tous ces espaces.
tagline.en: Restore a forgotten neighbourhood through your favourite hobby, one cozy room at a time. In Hozy, clean, paint, and decorate abandoned homes with satisfying mechanics and intuitive controls. Enjoy the little details as you interact with tools, items and furniture to bring each space back to life.

tagline.fr: Alors que nous explorons ces déserts gelés, le malheur frappe une fois de plus. À travers le blizzard intense, une fusée de détresse illumine le ciel, suivie par un appel à l'aide à la radio, cassé, agonisant... Personne d'autre ne peut venir les sauver. Mais nous pouvons rentrer... ensemble ?
tagline.en: As we explore these frozen wastes, misfortune strikes once again. Through the fierce blizzard, a flare lights the sky, followed by a cry for help over the radio - broken, dying... No one else can come to their rescue. Can we make it back - together?

tagline.fr: À l’approche de votre dernière heure, une immense bâtisse se profile au loin – surplombant une tempête déchaînée. Découvrez la vérité sur ce lugubre château dans une aventure coopérative fondée sur la communication.
tagline.en: As your final hour approaches, a large structure looms up in the distance, towering above the relentless storm. Discover the truth behind this dark castle in a communication-based, cooperative puzzle adventure.

tagline.fr: Rangez les cassettes, débloquez des compétences et utilisez vos méthodes pour ranger les archives TV. Profitez de la coop et du JcJ en ligne avec vos amis, ou jouez en solo ! Remplissez les étagères et ressentez un profond sentiment de satisfaction.
tagline.en: Shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

title: Looking For Fael
developer: Swing Swing Submarine, La Poule Noire, ARTE France

tagline.fr: Hello, c’est Fael… Écoute, ça va te paraître bizarre, mais… je crois que je me suis perdu dans l’appartement. Là…je… je sais pas où je suis. Tu peux venir m’aider ?
tagline.en: Hello, this is Fael... Listen, this is going to sound strange, but... I think I'm lost in the apartment. Right now... I... I don't know where I am. Can you come and help me?

tagline.fr: A deep automation and programming game on a frozen alien planet. Write real code to drive rovers, run power grids, fabricate parts, and fly drone fleets across the world. Your scripts run while you plan your next move. The more you terraform, the more the planet responds.
tagline.en: A deep automation and programming game on a frozen alien planet. Write real code to drive rovers, run power grids, fabricate parts, and fly drone fleets across the world. Your scripts run while you plan your next move. The more you terraform, the more the planet responds.

tagline.fr: Mettez les produits en rayon, débloquez de nouvelles compétences et utilisez vos méthodes uniques pour ranger le centre commercial. Profitez de la coop et du JcJ en ligne avec vos amis, ou jouez en solo ! Remplissez les étagères et ressentez un sentiment de soulagement et de satisfaction.
tagline.en: Shelve the products, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the mall. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

tagline.fr: As a terrible storm rages on, a young girl tries to survive in a HOUSE hell-bent on killing her and her family...
tagline.en: As a terrible storm rages on, a young girl tries to survive in a HOUSE hell-bent on killing her and her family...

tagline.fr: Vous vous sentez dépassé ? Salut, moi c’est Molly. J’aide les gens à trier leur espace, organiser leurs affaires et retrouver du calme dans leur vie. Avançons objet par objet pour rendre tout plus ordonné. Racontez-moi votre histoire. Je suis là pour vous écouter.
tagline.en: Feeling overwhelmed? Hi, I’m Molly. I help people sort their space, organize their belongings, and bring calm back into their lives. Let’s take it one object at a time and make everything feel neat again. Tell me your story. I’m here to listen.

tagline.fr: Le temps ? Votre meilleure ressource. Les secrets, vos améliorations. Maîtrisez une boucle temporelle défaillante dans ce Metroidvania axé sur les connaissances. Dernier tisseur, tirez parti des anomalies et rompez le cycle. Explorez les vestiges. Percez le mystère. Perfectionnez la boucle.
tagline.en: Time is your greatest resource and secrets are your only upgrades. Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

tagline.fr: Un jeu de tri apaisant dans un petit atelier à Tokyo. Des clients t'apportent des boîtes en vrac : boutons, pièces de monnaie, engrenages, timbres. Trie, regroupe, remets chaque chose à sa place, au son de clics ASMR satisfaisants. Sans chrono. Se tromper ne coûte rien. Le pur plaisir de ranger.
tagline.en: A cozy sorting game set in a quiet Tokyo workshop. Clients bring you boxes of clutter: buttons, coins, gears, stamps. Sort them, group them, and put everything back in its place, to satisfying ASMR clicks. No timers. Mistakes cost nothing. Just the joy of tidying up.

tagline.fr: The fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock unique trinkets, and deploy enhanced towers to overcome relentless waves of enemies and new strategic challenges.
tagline.en: The fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock unique trinkets, and deploy enhanced towers to overcome relentless waves of enemies and new strategic challenges.

tagline.fr: Aidez un chien robot à s’échapper d’une cité-machine dystopique dans ce tactical roguelite. Créez de puissantes attaques modulaires, planifiez chaque mouvement grâce à un aperçu en temps réel, et déclenchez des réactions en chaîne dévastatrices pour écraser des hordes de robots acharnés !
tagline.en: Train an AutoDog to escape a dystopian mecha-city in this tactical roguelite. Craft powerful modular attacks, plan every move with stress-free real-time previews, and unleash devastating chain reactions to outsmart hordes of killjoy robots!

tagline.fr: Construisez votre toupie et devenez Roi de la rue ! Collectez et combinez plus de 60 pièces, puis écrasez vos adversaires dans ce Roguelite chill ! Arpentez une ville des années 2000 haute en couleur, collectez de l'argent et des améliorations, et atteignez les sommets.
tagline.en: Build your battle-top and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts, Merge their Powers, and Dominate opponents in this Chill Roguelite! Skate around a vibrant Y2K city, winning Cash and Upgrades on your way to the top. And if you Die in the game, you Die in real life.

tagline.fr: Runeborn est un roguelike de dark fantasy qui associe construction de deck à une mécanique de type machine à sous. Forgez votre Grimoire runique, terrassez vos ennemis et combinez des Bibelots d’une puissance incommensurable pour anéantir les forces du Désespoir!
tagline.en: Runeborn is a dark fantasy roguelike that merges deckbuilding with a slot-machine-like mechanic. Forge your Runebook, crush enemies, and combine Trinkets of boundless power to destroy the forces of Malakar!

tagline.fr: Un jeu de cartes médiéval sombre dans lequel vous utilisez vos méthodes de guérison douteuses pour protéger les villageois bizarres de l'influence néfaste de maux anciens.
tagline.en: A grim medieval deckbuilder where you use your dubious healing methods to protect bizarre villagers from the corrupting influence of ancient evils.

tagline.fr: Welcome to ​Rhythm Animal Café​! Animals' daily chaos meets funky beats: boss hype, colleague woes, your slacking, unfair blame—all become hilarious one-tap rhythm games! Simple controls, joyful groove. Feel music fuse with daily life’s warmth!
tagline.en: Welcome to ​Rhythm Animal Café​! Animals' daily chaos meets funky beats: boss hype, colleague woes, your slacking, unfair blame—all become hilarious one-tap rhythm games! Simple controls, joyful groove. Feel music fuse with daily life’s warmth!

tagline.fr: Ils ont tué votre chat. Grosse erreur. Dans ce bullet-heaven roguelike saturé de magie, faites évoluer votre mage, améliorez vos sorts, récupérez des objets et créez des builds déwaistateurs face à des hordes d'ennemis.
tagline.en: They killed your cat. Fatal mistake. In this magic-infused bullet-heaven roguelike, develop your wizard, upgrade and evolve spells, collect items, and create unstoppable builds while battling hordes of enemies.

tagline.fr: « Haunted Heist » est un jeu d'horreur multijoueur en mode PvP, pour 3 à 8 joueurs, se déroulant par manches, dans lequel les Braqueurs doivent récupérer des gemmes dans un manoir généré procéduralement, tandis que les Filous utilisent des pouvoirs pour les perturber afin de protéger leur demeure.
tagline.en: Haunted Heist is a 3-8 player round-based PvP horror party game where Heisters find and retrieve gems in a procedurally generated mansion, while Tricksters use chaotic abilities to distress, disrupt, and dispose of them to protect their home.

tagline.fr: Hungry Horrors est un deckbuilder narratif ancré dans le folklore des îles Britanniques. Cuisinez de véritables plats traditionnels, enchaînez les synergies de saveurs, rencontrez des personnages mythiques et nourrissez de légendaires Horreurs avant qu'elles ne se nourrissent de vous.
tagline.en: Hungry Horrors is a story-driven deckbuilder set in the folklore of the British Isles. Cook real traditional dishes, chain flavour synergies, meet mythical characters, and feed legendary Horrors before they feed on you.

tagline.fr: Opus Magnum est le dernier jeu de puzzle ouvert créé par Zachtronics, le créateur de SpaceChem, Infinifactory et SHENZHEN I/O. Grâce au moteur de transmutation, l'outil le plus sophistiqué en ingénierie alchimique, développez et assemblez des machines pour créer des potions, poisons et bien plus !
tagline.en: Opus Magnum is the latest open-ended puzzle game from Zachtronics, the creators of SpaceChem, Infinifactory, and SHENZHEN I/O. Design and build machines that assemble potions, poisons, and more using the alchemical engineer’s most advanced tool: the transmutation engine!

tagline.fr: 3D Realms, creators of Duke Nukem 3D, Prey, and Max Payne, team up with Voidpoint to bring back the legendary Build Engine, famous for classic shooters like Duke Nukem 3D, Shadow Warrior, and Blood. Fast-paced FPS combat across huge, secret-packed levels. Ion Fury is the real deal!
tagline.en: 3D Realms, creators of Duke Nukem 3D, Prey, and Max Payne, team up with Voidpoint to bring back the legendary Build Engine, famous for classic shooters like Duke Nukem 3D, Shadow Warrior, and Blood. Fast-paced FPS combat across huge, secret-packed levels. Ion Fury is the real deal!

tagline.fr: SteamWorld Dig est de retour ! Creuse dans les profondeurs pour obtenir des richesses et affronte les terreurs du monde souterrain dans ce jeu de plateformes et d’aventure minière inspiré par Metroidvania.
tagline.en: SteamWorld Dig is back! Dig deep, gain riches and unearth the terrors of the underworld in this platform mining adventure influenced by classic Metroidvania style games.

tagline.fr: Explore higher dimensions... with golf! Conquer mind-bending challenges, design your own 4D courses, and unlock new worlds and accessories as you golf your way through the 4th dimension and beyond!
tagline.en: Explore higher dimensions... with golf! Conquer mind-bending challenges, design your own 4D courses, and unlock new worlds and accessories as you golf your way through the 4th dimension and beyond!

tagline.fr: Des néons, des palmiers, de la synthwave, des supercars des années 80 fonçant à toute vitesse sur une autoroute sans fin... Bienvenue dans le monde de la Retrowave !
tagline.en: Neon lights, palm trees, synthwave, '80s supercars speeding down an endless highway... Welcome to the world of Retrowave!

tagline.fr: Superflight is an intense, easy to learn wingsuit game with an infinite number of beautiful procedurally generated maps. A great game to relax for half an hour and chase your latest highscore!
tagline.en: Superflight is an intense, easy to learn wingsuit game with an infinite number of beautiful procedurally generated maps. A great game to relax for half an hour and chase your latest highscore!

tagline.fr: Un jeu de rallye rétro... dans des parkings ?! Une conduite précise avec des commandes réactives et précises inspirées des bornes d'arcade, le tout sous la forme d'un jeu Sega Saturn.
tagline.en: Retro Arcade Rally Racing... in Parking Garages?!? Precision driving with tight simple controls and arcade physics, all in a Sega Saturn style presentation

tagline.fr: Mind-altering sandbox game that can be described as a racing role-playing adventure game with a complicated storyline. You’ll find a unique atmosphere, complete freedom and lots of gameplay hours to figure out what’s the game is all about.
tagline.en: Mind-altering sandbox game that can be described as a racing role-playing adventure game with a complicated storyline. You’ll find a unique atmosphere, complete freedom and lots of gameplay hours to figure out what’s the game is all about.

tagline.fr: Travaillez à la création d'un empire de la distribution. Mettez la main à la pâte dans un jeu de simulation très réaliste qui accorde une grande attention aux détails. Visitez une nouvelle salle des ventes et achetez des voitures dans différentes conditions.
tagline.en: Work your way to a service empire. Get your hands dirty in a highly realistic simulation game that pays major attention to details. Pay a visit to a new Auction house and buy cars in various conditions. Expand your range of services by investing in a new work space and equipment.

tagline.fr: Liftoff® is a drone simulator that translates the rush of first-person view drone flight to the digital world. Join the biggest community for virtual FPV racing and freestyle!
tagline.en: Liftoff® is a drone simulator that translates the rush of first-person view drone flight to the digital world. Join the biggest community for virtual FPV racing and freestyle!

tagline.fr: Jouez avec votre propre musique.Audiosurf est un jeu où vous utilisez votre propre musique pour créer votre propre expérience. La forme, la vitesse et l'ambiance de chaque session sera déterminée par le choix de votre morceau.
tagline.en: Ride your music. Audiosurf is a music-adapting puzzle racer where you use your own music to create your own experience. The shape, the speed, and the mood of each ride is determined by the song you choose.

tagline.fr: Pilote FPV amateur ou expérimenté, apprenez ou améliorez vos compétences sur Uncrashed, le nouveau simulateur FPV ultra réaliste. Simulez votre propre drone FPV avec des paramètres basés sur des valeurs réelles et vous aurez les mêmes sensations qu'un vrai vol sans risque de casse !
tagline.en: Amateur or experienced FPV pilot, learn or improve your skills on Uncrashed,the new ultra realistic FPV simulator. Simulate your own FPV drone with settings based on real values and you will have the same feeling as a real flight without the risk of breaking your drone !

tagline.fr: Foncez dans un monde retrowave sublime à l'aide de vos compétences en parkour et un grappin qui vous permettront de grimper et courir sur les murs dans ce jeu de plates-formes 3D rapide. Faites exploser vos ennemis, manipulez l'espace-temps et défiez les lois de la physique pour éviter de tomber.
tagline.en: Speed through a gorgeous retrowave world using parkour skills and a grappling hook to scale and ride walls in this fast-paced, 3D platformer. Blast enemies, manipulate time and abuse physics to avoid falling to your death.

tagline.fr: SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell est le seul jeu de plates-formes à la première personne compétitif et heavy metal. Foncez à travers les niveaux à un rythme effréné en esquivant les pièges mortels qui vous y attendent.
tagline.en: Like a bastard child of Quake 3 and Super Meat Boy, SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell is truly hardcore and focuses on speed and fast reaction.

tagline.fr: DINOSAURS. PIXELS. PYROCLASTIC DOOM WALLS. Escape extinction in this colorful take on the classic prehistoric runner. Upgrade your raptor with new stats and cute hats, and then outrun the end of the world in endless, procedurally generated landscapes.
tagline.en: DINOSAURS. PIXELS. PYROCLASTIC DOOM WALLS. Escape extinction in this colorful take on the classic prehistoric runner. Upgrade your raptor with new stats and cute hats, and then outrun the end of the world in endless, procedurally generated landscapes.

tagline.fr: Ducks like to race, even in their own cars! Earn money by delivering food to fellow ducks in the city, then use this money to upgrade your vehicle. The better the vehicle, the better chance you have to win the race at the end of the day!
tagline.en: Ducks like to race, even in their own cars! Earn money by delivering food to fellow ducks in the city, then use this money to upgrade your vehicle. The better the vehicle, the better chance you have to win the race at the end of the day!

tagline.fr: Défiez vos amis dans une bataille navale dans laquelle vous allez devoir piloter, repousser et tirer. Pour survivre, gardez votre navire à l’écran et empêchez-le d’aller se fracasser sur la terre ferme. Jusqu'à 8 joueurs.
tagline.en: Challenge your friends in a naval battle of steering, pushing and shooting. Keep your ship on-screen and avoid crashing with land to survive. Up to 8 players. Or tackle the single-player challenges alone!

tagline.fr: A fast-paced movement game, loosely inspired by Surf and B-Hop. Featuring 5 gamemodes, multiplayer, and a large, playground-like world. Master the movement, and conquer the leaderboards.

tagline.en: Super House of Dead Ninjas is an action arcade game with roguelite elements. Race against a 30 second timer as you descend floor after foe-filled floor and attempt to unlock the secrets of this deadly tower!Play as the fearsome Crimson Ninja, wielding an arsenal of deadly ninja weapons and attacks.

tagline.fr: Freedom Planet est un jeu de plate-forme de combat inspiré de dessins animés où une dragonoïde téméraire et ses amies affrontent une attaque d'aliens.
tagline.en: Freedom Planet est un jeu de plate-forme de combat inspiré de dessins animés où une dragonoïde téméraire et ses amies affrontent une attaque d'aliens.

tagline.fr: 2121 A.D, with no escape options, Akane prepares for her final battle in the rain-soaked neon streets of Mega-Tokyo. Akane is an arena arcade slasher. Take out as many yakuza as possible, slashing and shooting in a one-hit-one-kill fight to the death.
tagline.en: 2121 A.D, with no escape options, Akane prepares for her final battle in the rain-soaked neon streets of Mega-Tokyo. Akane is an arena arcade slasher. Take out as many yakuza as possible, slashing and shooting in a one-hit-one-kill fight to the death.
